items.section: Forearm Joints and Connective Structures > Wrist and hand joints

items.section: Forearm Joints and Connective Structures > Retinacula and spaces
items.note: extensor retinaculum only; flexor retinaculum only in bodyparts (FJ1471/FJ1471M)
items.custom_note: Band arching from the pisiform and hook of the hamate to the scaphoid tubercle and trapezium, roofing the carpal tunnel (z-anatomy has only the extensor retinaculum); both sides; appended to the real extensor retinaculum.

items.section: Forearm Joints and Connective Structures > Retinacula and spaces
items.note: bounded by APL+EPB (SRC_Z_ABDUCTOR_POLLICIS_LONGUS_*, SRC_Z_EXTENSOR_POLLICIS_BREVIS_*) and EPL (SRC_Z_EXTENSOR_POLLICIS_LONGUS_*); floor scaphoid/trapezium (SRC_Z_SCAPHOID_BONE_*, SRC_Z_TRAPEZIUM_BONE_*); contains SRC_Z_RADIAL_ARTERY_*
items.custom_note: Triangular hollow on the radial side of the wrist between the tendons of abductor pollicis longus/extensor pollicis brevis (palmar side) and extensor pollicis longus (dorsal side), floored by the scaphoid and trapezium, where the real radial artery crosses; both sides.

items.section: Forearm Joints and Connective Structures > Retinacula and spaces
items.note: between carpal bones (SRC_Z_*carpal row ids) and flexor retinaculum (bodyparts FJ1471/FJ1471M); contains SRC_Z_MEDIAN_NERVE_*, SRC_Z_FLEXOR_DIGITORUM_PROFUNDUS_*, SRC_Z_FLEXOR_POLLICIS_LONGUS_*
items.custom_note: Passage between the carpal bones and the built flexor retinaculum, drawn as the volume around the real long flexor tendons (FDP, FDS, FPL) and median nerve at the wrist; both sides.

items.section: Forearm Joints and Connective Structures > Retinacula and spaces
items.note: between SRC_Z_PISIFORM_BONE_* and hook of SRC_Z_HAMATE_BONE_*; contains SRC_Z_ULNAR_NERVE_*, SRC_Z_ULNAR_ARTERY_*
items.custom_note: Ulnar canal at the wrist between the pisiform (medial) and the hook of the hamate (lateral), palmar to the flexor retinaculum, where the ulnar nerve and artery pass into the hand (the real ulnar nerve mesh stops just above the wrist); both sides.
